title: Use getSelectedUIDs/getSelectedItemRefs instead of inlining selection filtering
answers: How do I get the selected folder/dashboard UIDs in browse-dashboards?
Where should selection-filtering logic live for the dashboard tree?
getSelectedFolderUIDs was removed, what replaces it?
body: Local convention: selected folder/dashboard UIDs must be read via public/app/features/browse-dashboards/utils/dashboards.ts:getSelectedUIDs(selectedItems, kind) or getSelectedItemRefs, not via ad-hoc `Object.keys(selectedItems.folder).filter(uid => selectedItems.folder[uid])`. This PR replaced ~6 duplicated inline copies (BrowseActions.tsx, DeleteModal.tsx, MoveModal.tsx, AffectedFolderContents.tsx, BulkDeleteProvisionedResource.tsx, hooks.ts) with the shared helper and deleted the duplicate getSelectedFolderUIDs in BrowseActions/utils.ts. collectSelectedItems (same file) now builds on getSelectedItemRefs for provisioning resource refs. New selection-reading code in browse-dashboards or provisioning bulk actions should import from this module rather than re-deriving the filter.
applies: browse-dashboards and provisioning bulk-action code that reads DashboardTreeSelection
